what_to_detect: Determine whether the item is a pre-packaged commodity intended for retail sale before applying retail-package checks.
Do not blindly apply retail-sale declaration checks to packages covered by the industrial/institutional exclusion; route to applicable provisions.
Detect name and address information for manufacturer/packer; imported packages require importer information as applicable.
Detect country-of-origin declaration for imported products.
Detect common or generic name of commodity; for multi-product packages identify each product and its quantity where applicable.
Detect net quantity in applicable standard unit of weight/measure/number.
Detect month and year of manufacture/pack/import as applicable under current rule text.
Detect best-before/use-by date where the commodity becomes unfit for human consumption after a period.
Detect retail sale price in the required form and inclusive-of-taxes indication where applicable.
Detect unit sale price where required; normalize to the applicable unit and precision.
Detect declared dimensions where dimensions are relevant to the commodity; support multiple pieces with differing dimensions.
Detect consumer-care contact details such as address/telephone/email as applicable.
Locate mandatory declarations on the principal display panel where required.
Check that the area surrounding the quantity declaration satisfies the required clear-space geometry.
Assess whether required declarations are legible and prominent; poor image quality should lead to REVIEW rather than a legal failure.
Check contrast of MRP and net-quantity numerals against background, subject to the rule's exceptions for molded/blown/formed information.

requirement: No need to read through liquid
what_to_detect: Flag layouts where a required declaration can only be read through the contained liquid.
Verify that required particulars are available in Hindi (Devanagari) or English; additional languages may be present.
Use mass for solid/semi-solid/viscous or solid-liquid mixtures unless a schedule provides otherwise.
Use volume for liquids/cubic measure unless a schedule provides otherwise.
Use length for commodities sold by linear measure.
Use area for commodities sold by area measure.
Use number when commodity is sold by number, subject to the schedules.
For quantities below the larger standard threshold, validate use of the applicable smaller unit (e.g., g/ml/cm as prescribed).
Where quantity alone is insufficient to convey dimensions or count, check required additional declarations.
Flag words/phrasing that create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression of quantity.
If the commodity is in the applicable standard-pack schedule, validate the declared pack size against the current schedule.
Where permitted to use a non-standard size for a scheduled commodity, check the prescribed non-standard-size declaration.
For grouped promotional retail packages, check each retail package against applicable declarations.
Detect manufacturer/importer/packer identity, commodity identity and total number of retail packages or net quantity as applicable.
For packages containing sheets such as foil/tissues/paper where covered, detect number of usable sheets and sheet dimensions.
For container-type commodities, validate count and prescribed dimensions based on shape/type.
Ensure imported package workflow checks importer information in addition to general declarations.
For commodities manufactured outside India but packed in India, apply the additional India packer/importer declaration requirement.
E-commerce entities selling imported products must provide a searchable/sortable country-of-origin filter under the 2026 amendment effective 2026-07-01, subject to later amendment.
From 2027-07-01, the listing of an imported product must contain a searchable/sortable filter specifying country of origin under the second 2026 amendment.
From 2026-02-01, the earlier small-pack exemption was replaced so pan masala packs must display RSP and other applicable mandatory declarations regardless of pack size.
Route medical-device packages through the applicable Medical Devices Rules / Legal Metrology interaction rather than blindly applying the generic package checklist.

requirement: Agricultural produce up to 50 kg advisory
what_to_detect: Apply the Department's advisory for agricultural farm-produce packages up to 50 kg and do not assume the generic retail checklist is sufficient.
For edible oils/fats, use the Department's SOP for determination of net quantity as the measurement procedure layer.
Importers may make mandatory declarations at AEO Tier-2/Tier-3 bonded warehouses; retail packages must have all mandatory declarations before leaving the bonded warehouse.
For applicable registered company/firm records, capture the director responsible for violations under the Act/rules as required by the 2026 amendment.
Support annual update of registration particulars, including address, products and country of origin, through the online portal where applicable.
Registration certificates remain valid until cancelled under the 2026 amendment.
Detect MRP/retail sale price in the prescribed consumer-facing form and validate arithmetic/unit-sale-price relationships where applicable.
Validate unit sale price against declared net quantity using the applicable unit convention and rounding requirements.
Do not require unit sale price where the current rule expressly exempts combination, group or multi-piece packages.
Check that an outer container/wrapper carries required declarations unless the rule's transparency/exception conditions are met.
If image quality, surface coverage, OCR confidence or scale is insufficient, return REVIEW rather than asserting legal non-compliance.
Where minimum character/numeral size applies, estimate only with reliable scale/calibration; otherwise route to REVIEW.
